reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend and the lookahead/shift constants rather than adding a parallel holiday path.

duplication.why: The non-working-day test lives in one isNonWorkingDay helper and the shift bound in one exported function; the private MAX_WEEKEND_SHIFT_DAYS in schedules/app.ts is removed in favour of it.

placement.why: The rule and its bounds sit in shared/schedules.ts next to the weekend logic; server callers only thread the config's holidays through.

scope.why: Only the type, the shared rule, its four callers, the rule-utils data mapping and tests are touched.

maintainability.why: Clean single definition; the 2 + 3*holidays bound is a coarse heuristic a maintainer has to trust from its comment.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All callers (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange, schedule-template) go through getDateWithSkippedWeekend with holidays.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the former local shift constant is replaced by the shared getMaxWeekendShiftDays.

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts getDateWithSkippedWeekend + isNonWorkingDay (and getMaxWeekendShiftDays/getDailyWeekendLookahead for bounds), used by every code path.
